newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk PM sees 1997 economic growth at 14 percent.
newsitem.headline: Turk PM sees 1997 economic growth at 14 percent.

text.p: Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan said economic growth in 1997 will reach 14 percent, sharply above expectations and compared with growth of around seven percent in 1996.
"This year the rate of growth will reach 14 percent rather than expected 4 percent," Erbakan told a meeting of deputies from his Welfare Party.
